source_identity: Docker Hub tag listing for the arigaio/atlas image (hub.docker.com/r/arigaio/atlas/tags)
author_or_issuing_body: Ariga, Inc. (publisher of the arigaio/atlas image)
publisher: Docker Hub (Docker, Inc.) — registry hosting; image published by Ariga, Inc.
source_family: Docker Hub public registry listing (independent of atlasgo.io documentation, corroborates but is a distinct source family)
method: Live retrieval of the public Docker Hub tag-listing page via automated web-fetch, directed to list every visible tag name and its shown last-pushed recency.
limitations: Docker Hub renders push recency as a relative string ('pushed about 19/20 hours ago') rather than an absolute timestamp; relevant_event_date above (2026-08-13) is derived by subtracting that relative offset from the 2026-08-14 retrieval date and is therefore approximate, not an exact date read off the page. The fetch tool summarized the tag list rather than returning the raw page/API JSON, so the full tag inventory (e.g. older historical tags, or a complete 'latest-*' matrix) may extend beyond what was captured. No inspection of the image contents (what 'community' vs. unsuffixed/'extended' tags actually differ by feature-wise) was performed here — that distinction is recorded as an open observation, not verified against a manifest or the image's entrypoint/feature set.
provenance: Retrieved via the WebFetch tool against https://hub.docker.com/r/arigaio/atlas/tags on 2026-08-14. Re-verify by visiting the URL directly; Docker Hub also exposes a tag-listing API endpoint for exact push timestamps.

raw_evidence.quote: Version 1.3.0 tags were pushed 12 days ago, and 1.2.3 tags approximately 2 months ago.

docker_image_availability.citation: hub.docker.com/r/arigaio/atlas/tags — tags 'latest', '1.3.1', and several '-community'/'-extended'/'-alpine'/'-distroless' variants, all confirmed present at retrieval time
docker_image_availability.rationale: A public, actively-updated image is confirmed directly against the registry listing itself (not a README or blog claim), satisfying the source_requirements constraint that Docker availability be verified against the registry. Exact image name to use in a CI pipeline: `arigaio/atlas:latest` or a pinned `arigaio/atlas:1.3.1`.

tag_variant_observation.classification: not applicable — observational note, not a construct classification
tag_variant_observation.citation: hub.docker.com/r/arigaio/atlas/tags — coexistence of unsuffixed, '-community', and '-extended' tag families at the same version number
tag_variant_observation.rationale: The registry publishes distinct '-community' and unsuffixed/'-extended' tag families per version. This raises the possibility that image-level feature availability (e.g. whether Pro-gated capabilities are compiled in/out) tracks the tag family, but this was not verified by inspecting image contents in this pass — recorded as an open question relevant to the licensing/commercial-tier finding, not resolved here.

contrary_evidence_search.result: No evidence of image removal, deprecation notice, or absence was found — the image is actively published with multiple tag families as of the retrieval date. A parallel ghcr.io listing was not separately checked in this pass; Docker Hub alone was sufficient to satisfy the registry-verification requirement, so ghcr.io was not pursued further (recorded as an unexplored angle, not a negative finding).
